messages.block6: A data protection officer is not legally required under German statutory law (Section 38 BDSG) and has therefore not been appointed.
messages.block8: We process personal data in full compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Unless more specific information is provided below, our data processing operations are based on the following legal bases:
messages.block9:
• Consent (Art. 6 (1) sentence 1 lit. a GDPR): The data subject has given consent to the processing of their personal data for one or more specific purposes.
  • Performance of a contract and pre-contractual requests (Art. 6 (1) sentence 1 lit. b GDPR): Processing is necessary for the performance of a contract to which the data subject is party or in order to take steps at the request of the data subject prior to entering into a contract.
  • Legal obligation (Art. 6 (1) sentence 1 lit. c GDPR): Processing is necessary for compliance with a legal obligation to which we are subject (e.g. statutory accounting and tax retention duties).
  • Legitimate interests (Art. 6 (1) sentence 1 lit. f GDPR): Processing is necessary for the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued by us or by a third party, except where such interests are overridden by the interests or fundamental rights and freedoms of the data subject.
messages.block10: We erase personal data as soon as the purpose of storage no longer applies, unless statutory retention obligations (in particular commercial and tax retention duties under Section 147 of the German Fiscal Code AO and Section 257 of the German Commercial Code HGB of up to 10 years for accounting-relevant records) preclude erasure.
messages.block11: 3. Provision of the Website, Web Hosting & Content Delivery Network (Cloudflare)
messages.block12: When accessing our website and web application, information is automatically transmitted to our service provider's servers by the browser used on your device. This information is temporarily stored in server log files.
messages.block13:
• Processed data types: IP address of the requesting device, date and time of access, name and URL of the retrieved file, data volume transferred, notification of successful retrieval, browser type and version, user operating system, and referrer URL (previously visited website).
  • Purpose of processing: Ensuring smooth connection setup, ensuring convenient website usage, evaluating system security and stability, and general administrative purposes.
  • Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) sentence 1 lit. f GDPR (legitimate interest in the secure and faultless delivery of our digital services).
  • Retention period: Log file information is stored for a maximum of 30 days for security purposes (e.g. to investigate misuse or fraud) and is thereafter deleted or fully anonymized.
messages.block14: • Cloudflare: We use the Content Delivery Network (CDN) and security services of Cloudflare, Inc. (101 Townsend St., San Francisco, CA 94107, USA; EU subsidiary: Cloudflare Germany GmbH, Rosental 4, 80331 Munich, Germany) to deliver, secure, and accelerate our online presence. All data traffic between your browser and our platform is routed through Cloudflare's global edge network, protecting our services against Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks and malicious traffic; Legal basis: Legitimate interest (Art. 6 (1) sentence 1 lit. f GDPR); International data transfer: Cloudflare is certified under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (DPF) and additionally relies on European Commission Standard Contractual Clauses; Data processing agreement: We have concluded a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) with Cloudflare; Website: https://www.cloudflare.com; Privacy Policy: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/; DPA: https://www.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-customer-dpa/.
messages.block16: Our website and web application use the Poppins and Inter typefaces. These fonts are integrated using the built-in, privacy-preserving font optimization feature of Next.js (next/font). The font files are hosted locally on our own servers and are delivered directly with the site assets. At no point is a connection established to Google servers or any other third-party servers, and no IP addresses are shared with external font providers.
messages.block17: 5. Cookies and Terminal Device Storage (Section 25 (2) No. 2 TDDDG)
messages.block18: Our platform exclusively uses cookies and browser storage mechanisms (LocalStorage) that are strictly technically necessary. We do not use any marketing, advertising, or third-party tracking cookies.
messages.block19:
• Legal basis: Section 25 (2) No. 2 TDDDG (German Telecommunications-Digital-Services-Data-Protection-Act). Storing information on the user's terminal equipment or gaining access to information already stored is strictly necessary in order to provide the telemedia service explicitly requested by the user. Subsequent processing is based on Art. 6 (1) sentence 1 lit. b GDPR (contract performance) and Art. 6 (1) sentence 1 lit. f GDPR (legitimate interest in the secure provision of terminal sessions and shopping carts).
  • Storage mechanisms utilized:

    – Session cookies for restaurant terminals (staff_session, order_session, availability_session): Set upon device pairing to secure kitchen displays and 86-availability switches. They expire when the terminal session ends or the window is closed.

    – Authentication tokens: Secure the sessions of signed-in restaurant owners.

    – LocalStorage (cart): Temporarily retains selected menu items and customized options in the guest's browser until checkout is completed or the cart is emptied.
messages.block20: Because only strictly technically necessary storage is used, consent via a cookie banner is not required by law.
messages.block22: To store, manage, and synchronize our platform data in real time (restaurant profiles, digital menus, table configurations, live orders, and user accounts), we use the cloud backend and database services of Convex, Inc. (444 De Haro Street, Suite 218, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA).
messages.block23:
• Purpose and legal basis: Providing a highly available, reactive backend system to process hospitality orders and administer restaurant accounts. Processing is based on Art. 6 (1) sentence 1 lit. b GDPR (contract performance) and Art. 6 (1) sentence 1 lit. f GDPR (legitimate interest in scalable and stable cloud infrastructure).
  • International data transfer: Data processing may take place on servers located in the United States. Transfers are safeguarded by Standard Contractual Clauses (Art. 46 (2) lit. c GDPR) and a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) pursuant to Art. 28 GDPR concluded with Convex, Inc.
  • Website: https://www.convex.dev; Privacy Policy: https://www.convex.dev/privacy.
messages.block25: For cashless payment processing on our platform, we use the services of Stripe. The service provider for users within the European Economic Area is Stripe Payments Europe, Ltd., 1 Grand Canal Street Lower, Grand Canal Dock, Dublin, D02 H210, Ireland (parent company: Stripe, Inc., 510 Townsend Street, San Francisco, CA 94103, USA).
messages.block26:
• Guest Payment Processing: When guests pay for an order using card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, or other supported payment methods, payment details (card token, transaction amount, currency, timestamp, IP address) are transmitted directly to Stripe via an encrypted interface (Stripe Checkout / Payment Element). Zackisch does not store full credit card numbers or sensitive payment authentication data; Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) sentence 1 lit. b GDPR (order contract performance).
  • Stripe Connect for Hospitality Merchants: Merchants link their dedicated payout account via Stripe Connect to receive order revenues directly, minus the Zackisch platform fee. During onboarding, Stripe collects mandatory identity verification data (Know Your Customer / KYC pursuant to anti-money laundering regulations), bank account details, and business entity information; Legal bases: Art. 6 (1) sentence 1 lit. b GDPR (contract performance) and Art. 6 (1) sentence 1 lit. c GDPR (compliance with anti-money laundering and financial compliance obligations).
  • Stripe's Role: Stripe acts as an independent data controller for regulated payment and financial services. For further details on data processing by Stripe, please visit the Stripe Privacy Center: https://stripe.com/privacy-center and the Stripe Services Agreement: https://stripe.com/legal/ssa.
  • International data transfer: Stripe relies on the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (DPF) and Standard Contractual Clauses of the European Commission.
messages.block27: 8. Guest Ordering System and Processor Role under Art. 28 GDPR
messages.block28: When placing an order via the QR code system (at the table or for pickup), we process the guest's order information (selected items, customizations, table number or pickup name, amount, timestamp, and the email address optionally or requiredly provided for receipt transmission).
messages.block29:
• Division of Roles: The contract for the supply and preparation of food and beverages is concluded exclusively between the guest and the respective restaurant. To the extent that Zackisch collects personal order data on behalf of the restaurant and transmits it to the kitchen display, Zackisch acts as a data processor pursuant to Art. 28 GDPR on behalf of the restaurant. The respective restaurant remains the primary data controller for the catering and hospitality relationship.
  • Purpose and legal basis: Forwarding orders to the restaurant kitchen, displaying the preparation status in the real-time order tracker, and delivering receipt confirmations via email; Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) sentence 1 lit. b GDPR.
messages.block30: 9. Merchant Accounts and Email Communication via SMTP
messages.block31: When creating and administering a restaurant account, we collect the owner's name, business email address, encrypted authentication credentials, business address, and operational settings. Transactional emails (one-time passwords / OTP login codes, password reset links, order confirmations) are transmitted via a secure SMTP mail server. The legal basis is Art. 6 (1) sentence 1 lit. b GDPR.
messages.block33: Under the General Data Protection Regulation, you have the following rights as a data subject vis-à-vis the controller:
messages.block34:
• Right of access (Art. 15 GDPR): You have the right to request confirmation as to whether personal data concerning you is being processed, and to obtain information about such data and details pursuant to Art. 15 GDPR.
  • Right to rectification (Art. 16 GDPR): You have the right to obtain without undue delay the rectification of inaccurate data or the completion of incomplete data stored with us.
  • Right to erasure (Art. 17 GDPR): You have the right to obtain the erasure of your personal data without undue delay, provided that one of the grounds listed in Art. 17 GDPR applies and no statutory retention obligations prevent erasure.
  • Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR): You have the right to obtain the restriction of processing where the statutory conditions are met.
  • Right to data portability (Art. 20 GDPR): You have the right to receive your personal data in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format or to demand transmission to another controller.
  • Right to object (Art. 21 GDPR): Where your personal data is processed on the basis of legitimate interests pursuant to Art. 6 (1) sentence 1 lit. f GDPR, you have the right to object at any time on grounds relating to your particular situation.
  • Right to withdraw consent (Art. 7 (3) GDPR): You have the right to withdraw previously granted consent at any time with effect for the future.
  • Right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR): You have the right to lodge a complaint with a competent data protection supervisory authority if you consider that the processing of your data infringes the GDPR. The supervisory authority responsible for our place of business is: Der Landesbeauftragte für den Datenschutz und die Informationsfreiheit Baden-Württemberg (LfDI BW), Lautenschlagerstraße 20, 70173 Stuttgart, Germany, Website: https://www.baden-wuerttemberg.datenschutz.de/.
